items.caption: A modern redraw of a Shang-style 少 form. Early spellings transcribed as 少 or 小 overlap in shape and use, and the strokes’ referent remains uncertain.
items.alt: Four separate black strokes on white: one long vertical oval above, two shorter strokes at the sides, and a short slanting stroke below.
items.selection_reason: This form helps illustrate the reported early overlap between 少 and 小. Its shape does not establish what the strokes depict; the sand-grain interpretation is one proposal.

limitations.text: This modern redraw is not an artifact photograph, and no artifact date is established for the specific form shown. Early 少 and 小 spellings overlap; what the strokes originally depicted remains uncertain.
